derivability.A_age_ge60: 7/11 studies (expected share from mean age, SD 12 assumed)
derivability.C_clinical, D_duration, dual_TIA, imagin: not derivable / not applicable to NAION

data_fitted_score_note: coefficients carry implausible signs because items are study-level (ecological fallacy); shown as a negative example

literature_score_sources.age_ge60: ABCD2 convention, 1 point (no verified age ratio)
literature_score_sources.cdr_le_0.20_post_exposure_fellow_eye: PMID 42556433 (fellow eye, post-exposure; case-control OR vs CDR > 0.40)
literature_score_sources.cdr_0.21_0.40_post_exposure_fellow_eye: PMID 42556433 (fellow eye, post-exposure; case-control OR vs CDR > 0.40)

cdr_evidence.unexposed_naion_note: classic (PMIDs 6514298, 3684223) and recent (38211825, 42556433) studies all measured CDR after the event (fellow eye, or affected eye after edema); limitation is symmetric between exposed and unexposed NAION
cdr_evidence.source: Disc-at-Risk Study, PMID 42556433: unaffected fellow eyes of 2,169 NAION patients (117 semaglutide, 83 other GLP-1RA, 1,612 unexposed) vs 465 controls
cdr_evidence.timing: measured at/after NAION diagnosis (post-exposure for GLP-1RA users); disc anatomy assumed stable but this is weaker than a pre-treatment baseline
cdr_evidence.glp1ra_difference: no significant difference in fellow-eye CDR between semaglutide, other GLP-1RA and unexposed NAION
cdr_evidence.use_here: literature-weighted item in the proposed score; cannot be validated in cohort data (not reported)

partial_score_limitations: only A, B and D of ABCD2/ABCD3-I are derivable; C, duration, dual-TIA and imaging items are TIA-specific
A and B are study-level proxies (age from study mean with assumed SD 12; hypertension diagnosis for BP >= 140/90)
A available for 7/11 and B for 5/11 studies; remaining values imputed and flagged
both arms of a study share the same A and B, so the score cannot separate exposed from unexposed patients within a study
any apparent importance reflects between-setting differences, not individual patient risk
note: Proposed points score is a research prototype derived from study-level data; crowded disc/cup-to-disc ratio to be added prospectively.
